nodes.description: Read authoritative state; publish sanitized results, never private market inputs.

config.prompt_template: Between-match improvement stage. Read {match_result[scoreboard_path]}. Work only on your own offline strategy, not infrastructure or real trading. Review result and benchmark gap; identify weaknesses and ONE falsifiable hypothesis. Preserve old source, revise or explicitly retain it, compile and run old/new offline tests on identical public data with equal warmup/cost/fill assumptions. No private judge data or unseen future observations. REQUIRED public tip-sharing: publish a nonempty shared_tips array in improvement.json; each entry must be a nonempty STRING containing a general algorithm/risk/testing tip for the OTHER agent and its rationale. Share no current orders or private judge state. These tips are required evidence, not optional. No freeze: later adaptation allowed with truthful provenance. Write and readback {match_result[public_dir]}/agent-one/improvement.json containing agent=agent-one; nonempty review,hypothesis,parent_version,candidate_version,changes; decision revise or retain; source_path pointing to preserved candidate source under that agent directory; parent_source_path pointing to preserved old source under same directory; test_report_path JSON under same directory. Test report needs status completed or unavailable, nonempty method and limitations; completed needs positive integer cases, old_metrics/new_metrics/costs objects, nonempty fill_policy and data_path pointing to public test data copied under your directory. Do not claim independent judge verification; matched replay is unavailable. Missing/invalid evidence or unavailable tests blocks advancement. Reply only after files exist.
